custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location only, so its entry's detail page lists one location and one part.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154829-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154829-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.
  • The Part details panel shows the entry's description with a pencil icon beside it, then "Part number" with part A's number, Category, Manufacturer, Measurement and "Total parts" 1.
  • The Parts table lists one row, under Workplace, for the test location.
  • No Delete button is shown anywhere on the detail page: the pencil is the page's only edit control.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens, holding the entry's values.
  • A Delete button sits at the bottom left of the window. It is dimmed, because part A uses the entry.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the entry is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • S11-R3c: “While an inventory part, an open part request or a part return still uses the entry, the Delete button is disabled and hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."”
  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a Part Library entry is titled "Edit Library Part".”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 12: “Board 7.2 is right: the page has no Delete button. Delete sits bottom left in the "Edit Library Part" window, opened by the pencil beside the entry's name (S11-R3). While a part uses the entry, Delete is disabled with the hover text "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." (S11-R3c).”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 20: “Yes, the board 7.2 note is out of date. Follow the page: the detail page has no Delete. Delete is in the "Edit Library Part" window (S11-R3).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "7.2 An entry opens its detail page". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

The board 7.2 note quoted below says the entry "can be edited and deleted" on its page. Product confirmed on 27 Oct 2026 (answer 20) that this note is out of date: the detail page has no Delete, and Delete is in the "Edit Library Part" window. The expected results follow the PRD.
